chunks.arabic_text: عَدَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Ismail ibn Jabir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ نَبَأُ مَا قَبْلَكُمْ وَخَبَرُ مَا بَعْدَكُمْ وَفَصْلُ مَا بَيْنَكُمْ وَنَحْنُ نَعْلَمُهُ

translations.en: The Book of Allah contains the account of what came before you, the report of what will come after you, and the judgment of what is between you, and we know it.

en.summary: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that the Quran contains comprehensive knowledge of past events, future occurrences, and resolutions for current differences, and that the Imams possess full knowledge of this content.
en.seo_question: What does the Quran contain according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.نَبَأُ: Account or news of past events
key_terms.خَبَرُ: Report or information about future events
key_terms.نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُهُ: We know it (referring to the Imams' comprehensive knowledge)
